finding.evidence: form with fields card, exp, cvv posted to http://
finding.description: Card numbers travel in clear and are handled by the shop itself.

recommendation.goal: What is the recommended fix for this web security flaw: card-data-over-http (Card numbers travel in clear and are handled by the shop itself. Evidence: form with fields card, exp, cvv posted to http://). State the concrete fix and cite a primary source (OWASP, MDN, NIST, PCI DSS, IETF RFC, or the vendor's own advisory).

fix.summary: Remove card/exp/cvv inputs from checkout pages and stop storing/echoing PAN, delegating to external PSP token.
fix.risk: Checkout page layout changes; custom card-field styling or JS selectors could break.
